window_covered: After the US close on Thursday 13 August 2026 through before the US open on Friday 14 August 2026

shortlist.selection_rationale: GenAI-disruption-to-demand narrative with peer read-throughs (Accenture, EPAM) already reported; history of violent guidance-driven gaps makes this a strong synthesis setup.
LatAm cross-border payments name with a history of violent reactions to take-rate and FX commentary; complex multi-country flow-through rewards synthesis.
Brazilian fintech/payments name with sharp historical post-print moves on take-rate and credit trends; macro plus competitive dynamics complex enough for real edge.
Mega-cap but semicap swings hard on China export-control and AI-capex commentary; deep liquid options and a genuinely complex supply-chain/geopolitics story reward synthesis.
Small-cap RF-geolocation/space-intel name where government contract cadence and backlog detail are under-analyzed and can be pieced together from filings and press.
Lithium producer pre-announced a 6% production beat; move hinges on realized pricing/cost trajectory, which is trackable via public lithium-price and China EV data.
California cannabis cultivator sensitive to wholesale flower pricing and rescheduling headlines; state licensing and pricing data support decent synthesis edge.
Recent-IPO media name with a history of extreme, meme-like post-earnings swings; large expected move, but ai_edge only just clears the floor since ad/subscriber metrics aren't externally observable.
Small commercial-stage specialty pharma with multiple recently launched products; script-tracking and formulary data allow real triangulation of the launch curve rather than a pure binary.
Small-cap clinical biotech (rezpegaldesleukin/atopic dermatitis); large expected move, but ai_edge is exactly at the floor since the reaction hinges on trial data unknowable outside the company.
